dslRule:
/*!
<!id: replace-textutilities-indexof-null-check>
<!description: Replace usage of deprecated TextUtilities.indexOf with MultiStringMatcher for null checks (Java 8+).>
<!severity: WARNING>
*/
org.eclipse.jface.text.TextUtilities.indexOf($delimiters$, $text$, $offset$)[0] != -1
=>
org.eclipse.jface.text.MultiStringMatcher.indexOf($text$, $offset$, $delimiters$) != null
;;

verification.message: Transformed syntax tree does not equal afterExample
